props.gloss_en: what is [meant by] 'and the Lord God formed (וייצר) man' (Gen 2:7) written with two yods? -- the Holy One created two inclinations, one the good inclination and one the evil inclination
but we see that [an animal] damages and bites and kicks
rather, [the double yod is to be read] as R' Shimon ben Pazi [said]
R' Shimon ben Pazi: woe to me from my Creator (יוצרי), and woe to me from my inclination (יצרי)
or else, [the double yod is to be read] as R' Yirmeya ben Elazar [said]
R' Yirmeya ben Elazar: the Holy One created two faces in the first man
as it is said: 'behind and before You formed me' (Ps 139:5)
